lines.text: Solomon reigned over all the kingdoms from the Jordan to the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.
Solomon composed five thousand proverbs, and men of all nations came to listen to his wisdom.

problems.problem: Its true detail "Egypt" is named in line 5, which gives it away. Burn a detail no other line mentions.
It has 22 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.
